name: tmuxinator

on_project_first_start.description: Run on project start, the first time.

on_project_restart.description: Run on project start, after the first time.

on_project_exit.description: Run on project exit (detaching from tmux session).

pre_window.description: Runs in each window and pane before window/pane specific commands. Useful for setting up interpreter versions.

tmux_options.description: Pass command line options to tmux. Useful for specifying a different tmux.conf.

tmux_command.description: Change the command to call tmux.  This can be used by derivatives/wrappers like byobu.

startup_window.description: Specifies (by name or index) which window will be selected on project startup. If not set, the first window is used.

startup_pane.description: Specifies (by index) which pane of the specified window will be selected on project startup. If not set, the first pane is used.

attach.description: Controls whether the tmux session should be attached to automatically. Defaults to true.

enable_pane_titles.description: Enables the display of pane titles.

layout.description: The layout setting gets handed down to tmux directly, so you can choose from one of the five tmux standard layouts or specify your own.

panes.description: Panes are optional and are children of window entries.

description:
The project **my_project** lives in `/home/user/projects/my_project` and is launched through a Byobu‑wrapped tmux session named `my_project_socket`.  All panes start with `/bin/bash` and inherit the environment variable `RAILS_ENV=development`.  Before any windows are created the session runs the deprecated pre hook `echo Pre-deprecated hook`, and after everything finishes it runs `echo Post-deprecated hook`.  At startup the configuration executes the commands `echo Starting project…` and `bundle install`; on the very first launch it also runs `echo First time start`.  When the session is restarted later it prints `echo Restarting project…` and then starts the Rails server.  Detaching from the session triggers `echo Project exited`, while stopping the project runs `echo Stopping project` followed by `killall -9 rails`.  The rbenv version is locked to 2.7.5, the legacy cli argument `-2` is still passed, and the deprecated `tabs` entry creates an **editor** tab and a **logs** tab that points at `/var/log/my_project`.  Every pane begins with the command `export LANG=en_US.UTF-8`, tmux is invoked with the options `-f ~/.tmux.conf`, and the session is set to attach automatically (`attach: true`, `tmux_detached: false`).  Pane titles are enabled, displayed at the bottom, and formatted as `#{pane_index} - #{pane_title}`.  On launch the window named `editor` is selected, and within that window the first pane (index 0) is focused.

Two windows are defined.  The first is a simple window called **main** with no special layout.  The second window uses the **tiled** layout and runs a pre‑window sequence of `cd #{root}` and `source .env`.  Its panes are arranged as follows: the first pane opens `vim .`; the second pane is a numeric placeholder (`1`), which tmux interprets as a split; the third pane runs `git status` and also contains a monitor pane that launches `top` and `htop` with the note “monitoring tools”; the fourth pane is an explicit shell pane that starts `irb` and immediately executes `puts 'Hello from pane'`.  The startup window is set to **editor** and the startup pane index is 0.
